title: Tymeslot
author: Luka Karsten Breitig
description: A meeting scheduler application with CalDAV integration
postInstallMessage:
Thank you for installing Tymeslot!

Set PHX_HOST to your app domain, either on the Environment tab or by editing /app/data/.env, which is pre-filled with every supported variable, commented out (cloudron exec --app <domain> -- vi /app/data/.env). Values set on the Environment tab take precedence over that file. Restart the app after editing it.

The first user to register becomes the admin.
